verdict.rationale: gstack's own docs define each supported coding agent (Claude, Codex, Cursor, Factory, Kiro, OpenCode, Copilot, and others) as a typed host config consumed by its generator and setup. It also ships a compressed AGENTS.md digest for hosts without a full skill install, so the same collection is clearly built to target multiple harnesses. However, the pack never shows actual per-harness install instructions or steps for Codex, Cursor, and the rest, and there is no hands-on confirmation that installs work outside Claude Code. missing for 10: documented per-harness install instructions for each agent, hands-on or independent corroboration of non-Claude installs.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install the same collection into multiple different coding agents — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and others — with per-harness instructions

citations.quote: Each supported AI coding agent (Claude, Codex, Factory, Kiro, OpenCode, Slate, Cursor, OpenClaw, Hermes, GBrain, Copilot, Antigravity) is defined as a typed TypeScript config
Adding a new host means creating one file and re-exporting it. Zero code changes to the generator, setup, or tooling.
Behavioral rules from gstack (https://github.com/garrytan/gstack), compressed for agent hosts without a full skill install.
